name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.global_watchlist.GlobalWatchlistActivity
description: When the flow includes a global-watchlist check, this screen collects identifying details such as name, birth date, and country, then shows the screening result. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing verification flows that require global-watchlist screening.
